phrases.chinese: 付出和接受，让事情，非常公平。

phrases.english: Slow down, beautiful, I'm watching you.
phrases.chinese: 慢点儿, 美丽的, 我在看你。

phrases.english: Give it time, darling, it's worth it.
phrases.chinese: 给它时间, 亲爱的, 值得。

phrases.english: Wait for me, sweetie, I'm coming.
phrases.chinese: 等我一下, 甜心, 我来了。

phrases.english: No hurry, my love, we have all night.
phrases.chinese: 不着急, 我的爱, 我们有整晚。
我们耐心点, 一起, 好吗？

phrases.english: One day at a time, right?
You can do it, for sure.
Learn a little, each day, my friend.
Listen more, speak less, you'll learn.
A good beginning, half the work, done.
Patience, is a virtue, you know.
phrases.chinese: 耐心，是一种美德，你知道。

phrases.english: Joy, like a flower, blooms from within.
Laughter, echoes loudest, where love lives.
phrases.chinese: 笑声，最响亮，在爱的地方。

phrases.english: Peace, a quiet harbor, for tired souls.
phrases.chinese: 平静，静静港湾，给累的心。

phrases.english: Contentment, a warm blanket, on a cold day.
Gratitude, opens doors, to more good things.
Good things take, time to grow.
Keep going, don't give up now.
Trust the process, it will work.
New day, new start, feel it.
phrases.chinese: 新的一天，新的开始，感受它。

phrases.english: Breathe deep, let go, you got this.
Quiet mind, happy heart, that's the key.
Chill out, my friend, it's all good.
Find your zen, then conquer the world.
Inner peace, is the best accessory.
A persistent drop, wears away stone.

phrases.chinese: 耐心，会结出甜美的果实。

phrases.english: The strongest person, is the one who gets up.
phrases.chinese: 最强的人，是那个站起来的。

phrases.english: A small seed, becomes a mighty tree.

phrases.chinese: 享受当下, 珍贵瞬间。
你的努力, 闪闪发光。
活在当下, 感受喜悦。
持续学习, 不断成长。
传播善意, 会有回响。

phrases.english: Try new things, break your limits.
Make mistakes, that's how we learn.
Small steps, build the road ahead.
Every try, is a chance to learn.
Keep going, the end is close.
A small seed, holds a forest.
Plant a thought, harvest an action.
Even a long journey, starts with one step.

phrases.chinese: 你的口音, 是你的风格。

phrases.english: Learn one word, use it now.
Thank you, for this good day.

phrases.chinese: 感恩的心，看见更多美好。

phrases.english: Don't give up, I believe in you.
One more time, you got this.
Push a little, you're almost there.
Let it go, and move on.
It's okay, we all make mistakes.
Eat real Chinese food, then learn.
Plant seeds of kindness, watch them bloom.
Listen to your heart, it whispers truths.
Tiny steps, big progress, you'll see.
Mistakes are fuel, for your learning.
Your voice matters, speak it out.
Friends are like stars, you don't always see them, but they're always there.
phrases.chinese: 朋友像星星，常看不见，但总在那。

phrases.english: A good friend, helps you grow, like sunshine.
True friends, share your laughter, and your tears.
Friendship is a journey, let's walk it together.
phrases.chinese: 友谊是旅程，我们一起走。

phrases.english: In difficult times, friends are anchors, steady and strong.
Try again, you can do it!
Practice makes perfect, keep at it.
Slow down, and enjoy the view.
Every little bit, counts a lot.
One day at a time, you'll get there.
Let it bloom, when it's ready.

phrases.chinese: 不怕犯错, 只管学习。
继续努力, 找到力量。

phrases.english: Never quit, if you want it.
Humming a tune, calms your nerves.
Can I see you, again soon?
A warm meal, feels like home.
Your accent, is music, to me.
Learning Chinese, with you, is fun.
phrases.chinese: 和你一起学中文，很有趣。

phrases.english: Keep going, the sun will rise.
A small seed, grows a big tree.
Don't fear the wind, learn to dance.
Every step counts, towards your goal.
The darkest night, has a morning.
Open your mind, grow your world.
A kind word, warms the heart.

phrases.chinese: 非常感激, 所有一切。

phrases.english: My heart, is full, of thanks.
phrases.chinese: 我心里, 满是, 谢意。

phrases.english: My heart, beats for you, fast.
Your smile, lights up, my day.
My world, became brighter, with you.

phrases.chinese: 你是我最爱的，人类零食。

phrases.english: My heart does a little, happy dance, for you.
phrases.chinese: 我的心为你，跳起了，快乐的小舞。

phrases.english: You make my boring life, super fun.
phrases.chinese: 你让我的无聊生活，变得超级有趣。

phrases.english: Thinking of you, makes me smile, like an idiot.
phrases.chinese: 想到你，我就会，傻傻地笑。

phrases.english: You're the pineapple, on my pizza.

phrases.chinese: 现在就开始, 别犹豫。

phrases.english: Empty your cup, to be filled.
phrases.chinese: 倒空杯子, 才能被装满.

phrases.english: Let go, of what weighs you down.
phrases.chinese: 放下, 让你沉重的东西.
我们一起, 到那儿, 好吗？

phrases.english: Don't give up, on us, yet.
phrases.chinese: 别轻易, 放弃, 我们。

phrases.english: Happiness, is a choice, you make.
Small joys, build, a big life.

phrases.chinese: 你的微笑，照亮，别人一天。
哎呀, 我错了.  对不起!

phrases.english: A good friend, a treasure, for life.
Trust is the glue, that holds friendship.
You understand me, like no other.

phrases.chinese: 你是我, 最喜欢的人。

phrases.english: I really, like you a lot.
I want to, be with you.
Little by little, a journey begins.
phrases.chinese: 一步一步, 路就到了。

phrases.english: Wait for the right time, to bloom.

phrases.chinese: 深挖下去, 宝藏就露。
我们一起，写我们的故事。
我们在一起，什么都能建。

phrases.english: You inspire me, to be better.
My heart beats, for your creativity.
Even a tiny seed, holds a forest.
phrases.chinese: 小小种子，能藏一片森林。

phrases.english: Every little step, builds a mountain.
phrases.chinese: 每一步小路，都能通向高山。

phrases.english: Failure is just a pause, not an end.
phrases.chinese: 失败只是暂歇，不是终点。

phrases.english: Learning a word, opens a new door.

phrases.chinese: 和你在一起，一切都好轻松。

phrases.english: You make me, want to learn more.
This moment, is perfect with you.
Your presence, is my favorite gift.
phrases.chinese: 你在身边，是我最喜欢的礼物。
我们来分享，一个甜蜜的时刻。

phrases.english: The best is, yet to come.
A new thought, sparks a fire.
Little by little, you'll master it.
phrases.chinese: 一点一滴, 你会掌握。
每天练习, 这是秘诀。
错也是好, 它们教你。

phrases.english: Connect the dots, see the progress.
phrases.chinese: 串联起来, 看见进步。

phrases.english: Your voice matters, try saying it.
My brain just did a happy dance!
This feels so good, like winning the lottery!
phrases.chinese: 这感觉太棒了，像中彩票！

phrases.english: Aha moment! My brain lit up!
Nailed it! So proud of myself!
Learn new words, daily, my friend.
Listen more, speak less, for now.
Think in Chinese, it helps a lot.
Record your voice, hear the changes.
Don't fear errors, just be clear.
Study hard, eat well, then play!
phrases.chinese: 努力学习，好好吃饭，再玩！

phrases.english: Language is a journey, not a race.

phrases.chinese: 犯错？它们只是绕路，朋友们！

phrases.english: One new phrase, every day, please!
Your mouth is ready, let's go!
Listen to whispers, catch the drift.

phrases.chinese: 别担心, 像棉花糖一样!

phrases.english: Keep going, you got this, buddy!
phrases.chinese: 继续加油, 你可以的, 伙伴!
再试一次, 然后吃零食!

phrases.english: Your brain is a champ, fuel it!
phrases.chinese: 你脑子是冠军, 加油喂!
忘掉旧错误, 拥抱今天。
犯错很正常, 没关系。
放下吧, 继续前进, 朋友。
卸下心头重担, 轻松些。

phrases.english: Every word, a tiny seed, friend.
Your voice, a unique sound, see?
Explore ideas, like a curious cat.
Create something new, from simple things.
phrases.chinese: 创造新东西，从简单开始。

phrases.english: Let your imagination, paint the world.
Build with joy, brick by brick.
A closed door, doesn't block the sun.
No one remembers, every single fall.
Think of a new idea, then share it.
Be brave, try something different, okay?
A small spark, can light a big fire.
Connect your thoughts, find a new way.
Your inner world, is your masterpiece.
Speak a phrase, build a bridge.
Write it down, make it stick.

phrases.chinese: 你的中文，越来越可爱了。

phrases.english: Don’t say “I Chinese”, say “I speak Chinese”.
phrases.chinese: 别说“我中国”，说“我会说中文”。

phrases.english: Stop “where you are”, say “nǐ zài nǎlǐ”.
phrases.chinese: 别说“where you are”，说“你在哪儿”。

phrases.english: Breathe, slow down, say the word again.
phrases.chinese: 先喘口气，慢一点，再说一遍。
你要说“真的吗”，别说“很”，简单点。

phrases.english: Say it softly, I’ll listen closely, okay?
phrases.chinese: 你先慢点说, 我会认真听, 好吗？

phrases.english: Meet me in Mandarin, we’ll start with one word.
phrases.chinese: 用普通话找我, 我们先从一个词开始。

phrases.english: Smile and repeat, your tongue will relax.
phrases.chinese: 笑着重复, 你嘴会更放松。

phrases.english: Casual practice, you and I, just breathe, go.
phrases.chinese: 轻松练习, 你和我, 呼吸一下, 开始。

phrases.english: Make mistakes now, I’ll cheer for you.
phrases.chinese: 现在可以错, 我会为你加油。

phrases.english: Best friends, share snacks, like family roots.
phrases.chinese: 好朋友, 分着零食, 像家人一样。

phrases.english: Friends check in, 见面笑, you feel warm.
phrases.chinese: 朋友常关心, 见面就笑, 心里暖。

phrases.english: A real friend, listens first, then answers.
phrases.chinese: 真正朋友, 先听再说, 不急着答。

phrases.english: We walk together, 你在, 我也在。
phrases.chinese: 我们一起走, 你在, 我也在。

phrases.english: Old friends, call anytime, 听见就想你。
phrases.chinese: 老朋友, 随时联系, 听见就想你。

phrases.english: I’m trying, not I try, keep going.
phrases.chinese: 我在努力，不是我努力了，继续吧。

phrases.english: Don’t quit, small study, daily practice.
phrases.chinese: 别放弃，少学也行，每天练。

phrases.english: Say it again, slowly, your mouth learns.
phrases.chinese: 再说一次，慢一点，你的嘴会学。

phrases.english: Not perfect yet, just more practice, please.
Time is short, review fast, don’t stop.
phrases.chinese: 时间不长，快速复习，别停。

phrases.english: Hope grows, when you learn one new word.
phrases.chinese: 希望在长大, 你学会一个新词.

phrases.english: Hope is simple, say one sentence today.
phrases.chinese: 希望很简单, 今天说一句话.

phrases.english: Hope surprise, tones help you sound better fast.
phrases.chinese: 希望有惊喜, 声调让你更快更准.

phrases.english: Hope facts, practice listening before speaking.
phrases.chinese: 希望的事实, 先练听再说.

phrases.english: Hope is a routine, review just five minutes.
phrases.chinese: 希望是习惯, 只复习五分钟.

phrases.english: Hello, breathe in, learn the sound, go!
phrases.chinese: 你好，先深呼吸，学发音，出发！

phrases.english: I mess up, then I laugh, keep learning!
phrases.chinese: 我说错了，我笑一笑，再学一次！

phrases.english: One more word, then tea break, repeat!
phrases.chinese: 再学一个词，喝口茶，再来！

phrases.english: Tones first, then words, your brain likes it.
phrases.chinese: 先练声调，再学词，你大脑会喜欢。

phrases.english: Slow down, say it right, then speed up!
phrases.chinese: 慢一点，说对了，再快一点！

phrases.english: Hope wins, you smile, try again, okay?
phrases.chinese: 希望会赢, 你笑一下, 再试一次, 好吗？

phrases.english: Lucky day, one new word, your turn, okay?
phrases.chinese: 幸运的一天, 一个新词, 轮到你了, 好吗？

phrases.english: Dream sweet, small practice, meet your future.
phrases.chinese: 梦想甜一点, 小练习, 去见未来。

phrases.english: Say hi more, confidence rises, you’ve got this.
phrases.chinese: 多说你好, 信心就起来了, 你行的。

phrases.english: You study, I cheer, keep going, my friend.
phrases.chinese: 你学习, 我给你加油, 别停, 好朋友。

phrases.english: Confident face, small steps, daily Chinese, go!
phrases.chinese: 自信表情, 小步前进, 每天学中文, 走!

phrases.english: Copy me, stop laughing, then say it!
phrases.chinese: 跟我学, 别笑了, 然后说!

phrases.english: Mess up a little, smile, try again!
phrases.chinese: 错一点没关系, 笑一笑, 再来!

phrases.english: One page today, not huge, but steady.
phrases.chinese: 今天一页就行, 不用很大, 稳稳来。

phrases.english: Ask “What?” kindly, get the answer fast.
phrases.chinese: 礼貌问“什么”, 问到就快, 太好了!

phrases.english: Forgive first, then talk, you feel lighter.
phrases.chinese: 先原谅，再说话，你会轻松很多。

phrases.english: Let it go, we can start over.
phrases.chinese: 放下吧，我们可以从头开始。

phrases.english: It’s okay, mistakes happen, keep your heart open.
phrases.chinese: 没关系，出错很正常，心要打开。

phrases.english: Say sorry gently, then move forward together.
phrases.chinese: 轻轻说对不起，然后一起往前走。

phrases.english: Choose calm words, peace comes back fast.
phrases.chinese: 选平静的话，和平很快回来。

phrases.english: Smile first, Chinese feels lighter, right away.
phrases.chinese: 先微笑, 中文就轻松很多, 立刻。

phrases.english: Short study, big mood, you’ll notice soon.
phrases.chinese: 学一会儿, 心情变好, 很快你会发现。

phrases.english: Say the tone, breathe out, happiness follows.
phrases.chinese: 先说声调, 再呼气, 快乐就来了。

phrases.english: Make one sentence, you feel proud, fast.
phrases.chinese: 造一句话, 你会很快自豪。

phrases.english: No perfect, just practice, you’re improving.
phrases.chinese: 不求完美, 只练习, 你在变好。

phrases.english: Play with tones, meanings pop, wow, you get it.
phrases.chinese: 玩声调, 意思就出来了, 哇, 你懂了.

phrases.english: Draw a picture, then say it, quick and fun.
phrases.chinese: 先画图, 再说出来, 快又有趣.

phrases.english: Tap the rhythm, small pauses, words stick better.
phrases.chinese: 敲节奏, 小停顿, 词更好记.

phrases.english: Turn one joke, into a Chinese phrase, share it.
phrases.chinese: 把一个笑话, 变成一句中文, 去分享.

phrases.english: Make it your story, one sentence, then repeat.
phrases.chinese: 把它当故事, 一句话, 然后再说.

phrases.english: Say one new word, it sticks fast, instantly!
phrases.chinese: 说一个新词, 它会很快记住!

phrases.english: Point at things, your Chinese feels real, wow!
phrases.chinese: 指着东西学, 你的中文更真实!

phrases.english: Read out loud, your ears learn too, surprise!
phrases.chinese: 大声读出来, 你的耳朵也学会了!

phrases.english: Swap one word, same sentence, new meaning!
phrases.chinese: 换一个词, 同一句, 意思就变!

phrases.english: Use the same pattern, then add your idea, share!
phrases.chinese: 用同一个句型, 再加你的想法, 去分享!

phrases.english: Learn one tone daily, surprises feel easier, fast.
phrases.chinese: 每天学一个声调, 惊喜会更容易, 很快。

phrases.english: Say it slowly, native speakers still understand you.
phrases.chinese: 慢慢说, 本地人也听得懂你。

phrases.english: Use small wins, each day builds real confidence.
phrases.chinese: 小小胜利, 每天都在长自信。

phrases.english: Practice with one question, suddenly you can talk.
phrases.chinese: 只练一个问句, 突然就能聊天。

phrases.english: Write one sentence, your memory becomes stronger, wow.
phrases.chinese: 写一句话, 记忆会更强, 哇。

phrases.english: Good day, drink water, keep smiling
phrases.chinese: 好日子, 喝点水, 还要笑

phrases.english: Breathe in, relax your shoulders, feel light
phrases.chinese: 吸一口气, 放松肩膀, 心变轻

phrases.english: Say hello first, joy comes faster
phrases.chinese: 先说你好, 快乐来得快

phrases.english: Learn one word, then laugh a little
phrases.chinese: 学一个词, 然后笑一笑

phrases.english: When stuck, drink tea, try again
phrases.chinese: 卡住了, 喝杯茶, 再试试

phrases.english: Love first, then say it slowly
phrases.chinese: 先喜欢, 再慢慢说出来

phrases.english: I miss you, say it in Chinese
phrases.chinese: 我想你, 用中文说出来

phrases.english: You matter, I mean it, always
phrases.chinese: 你很重要, 我说真的, 一直都在

phrases.english: Be my person, let’s talk tonight
phrases.chinese: 做我的那个人, 今晚聊聊

phrases.english: Hold my hand, we’ll be okay
phrases.chinese: 牵着我的手, 我们会没事的

phrases.english: Forgive fast, peace returns to your mind, wow
phrases.chinese: 原谅得快，心里就更安静，真神奇

phrases.english: You can let go, saying sorry helps, seriously
phrases.chinese: 你可以放下，说对不起更有用

phrases.english: Don't keep score, you win by forgiving
phrases.chinese: 别总记账，原谅的人更轻松

phrases.english: Forgiveness is power, it frees your time, really
phrases.chinese: 原谅很有力量，它省下你的时间

phrases.english: Say, I understand, then you forgive easier
phrases.chinese: 先说我懂了，再学会原谅

phrases.english: Balance your day, not just your body.
phrases.chinese: 把一天过得均衡，别只顾身体。
phrases.transliteration: bǎ yī tiān guò de jūn héng, bié zhǐ gù shēn tǐ.
màn yī huìr, zài kuài yìdiǎnr.

phrases.chinese: 忙一点儿，也要保持善意。
phrases.transliteration: máng yìdiǎnr, yě yào bǎochí shàn yì.
xiū xī yě suàn, gōng zuò rì yí yàng.
màn man chī, zài qīng qīng dòng yí dòng.

phrases.chinese: 为小胜利喝彩,继续前进。
phrases.transliteration: Wéi xiǎo shènglì hé qì, jìxù qiánjìn.

phrases.chinese: 你敢尝试,自信就会增长。
phrases.transliteration: Nǐ gǎn chángshì, zìxìn jiù huì zēngzhǎng.

phrases.english: Slow down, your meaning stays clear.
phrases.transliteration: Fàng màn yīdiǎn, yìsi gèng qīngchǔ.

phrases.english: Use what you know, speak now.
phrases.transliteration: Yòng nǐ huì de, xiànzài jiù shuō.
Bié pà cuò, ràng cuòwù dàilù.

phrases.english: Hang in there, you’re learning fast.
phrases.transliteration: jiānchí zhe, nǐ xué de hěn kuài.

phrases.english: Breathe, relax, you can do it.
phrases.chinese: 深呼吸，放松点，你可以的。
phrases.transliteration: shēn hūxī, fàngsōng diǎn, nǐ kěyǐ de.

phrases.chinese: 小错也会带来更大的进步。
phrases.transliteration: xiǎo cuò yě huì dàilái gèng dà de jìnbù.

phrases.english: Keep your chin up, today’s okay.
phrases.transliteration: tái qǐ tóu, jīntiān yě méi wèntí.

phrases.chinese: 现在说一句，立刻更有信心。
phrases.transliteration: xiànzài shuō yí jù, lìkè gèng yǒu xìnxīn.

phrases.english: Say it out loud, with confidence.
phrases.chinese: 把它说出来, 很有信心。
phrases.transliteration: Bǎ tā shuō chūlái, hěn yǒu xìnxīn.

phrases.chinese: 小进步, 今天也很开心。
phrases.transliteration: Xiǎo jìnbù, jīntiān yě hěn kāixīn.

phrases.chinese: 对我眨眨眼, 传染快乐。
phrases.transliteration: Duì wǒ zhǎ zhā yǎn, chuǎn rǎo kuàilè.

phrases.english: New word, and you get it!
phrases.chinese: 新词学会了, 你真懂！
phrases.transliteration: Xīn cí xué huì le, nǐ zhēn dǒng!

phrases.english: Take a breath, then try again.
phrases.chinese: 先呼口气, 再试一次。
phrases.transliteration: Xiān hū kǒu qì, zài shì yí cì.

phrases.english: Thanks for always checking on me, 朋友.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你总来关心我，朋友。
phrases.transliteration: xie xie ni zong lai guan xin wo, peng you.

phrases.english: I’m glad you get my jokes, 哈哈.
phrases.chinese: 我很高兴你能懂我的笑话，哈哈。
phrases.transliteration: wo hen gao xing ni neng dong wo de xiao hua, haha.

phrases.english: Call me when you need help, ok?
phrases.chinese: 你需要帮忙就给我打电话，行吗？
phrases.transliteration: ni xu yao bang mang jiu gei wo da dian hua, xing ma?

phrases.english: Your company makes everything feel easier.
phrases.chinese: 有你在旁边，一切都更容易。
phrases.transliteration: you ni zai pang bian, yi qie dou geng rong yi.

phrases.english: We can vent, then laugh again.
phrases.chinese: 我们可以发牢骚，然后再笑。
phrases.transliteration: wo men ke yi fa lao sao, ran hou zai xiao.

phrases.english: Dream boldly, take practical steps today.
phrases.chinese: 大胆做梦, 也要脚踏实地。
phrases.transliteration: da dan zuo meng, ye yao jiao ta shi di

phrases.english: You can start again, right now.
phrases.chinese: 你可以从头再来, 就现在。
phrases.transliteration: ni ke yi cong tou zai lai, jiu xian zai

phrases.english: Your hard work will pay off.
phrases.chinese: 你的努力, 一定会有回报。
phrases.transliteration: ni de nu li, yi ding hui you hui bao

phrases.english: Even sunshine starts with a morning.
phrases.chinese: 好天气, 也从早晨开始。
phrases.transliteration: hao tian qi, ye cong zao chen kai shi

phrases.chinese: 说话温柔, 心也会轻些。
phrases.transliteration: shuo hua wen rou, xin ye hui qing xie

phrases.english: Practice when it's inconvenient, still do.
phrases.chinese: 不方便的时候，也要坚持练习。
phrases.transliteration: bù fāngbiàn de shíhou, yě yào jiānchí liànxí

phrases.english: Set a goal, then start now.
phrases.chinese: 定个目标, 然后马上开始。
phrases.transliteration: dìng gè mùbiāo, ránhòu mǎshàng kāishǐ

phrases.english: Relax your mind, speak more calmly.
phrases.chinese: 放松心态, 说得更从容。
phrases.transliteration: fàngsōng xīntài, shuō de gèng cóngróng

phrases.english: Don’t compare, just outgrow your past.
phrases.chinese: 别比较, 只要超越过去。
phrases.transliteration: bié bǐjiào, zhǐ yào chāoyuè guòqù

phrases.chinese: 请教别人, 这很勇敢。
phrases.transliteration: qǐngjiào biérén, zhè hěn yǒnggǎn

phrases.english: Breathe, take your time, it’s fine.
phrases.transliteration: Shēn hūxī, màn man lái, méi guānxi.

phrases.english: Wait a bit, then try again.
phrases.transliteration: Děng yí huìr, zài shì yí cì.

phrases.chinese: 别急，事情会慢慢平稳下来。
phrases.transliteration: Bié jí, shìqing huì màn man píngwěn xiàlái.

phrases.english: Slow is okay, you’ll catch up.
phrases.chinese: 慢一点也行，你会跟上的。
phrases.transliteration: Màn yìdiǎn yě xíng, nǐ huì gēn shàng de.

phrases.english: Let it go, don’t chase today.
phrases.transliteration: Fàngxià ba, bié zhuīzhe jīntiān pǎo.

phrases.english: Say thank you, it’s worth everything.
phrases.transliteration: Shuo sheng xiexie, zhen de hen zhidae.

phrases.english: Offer kindness first, no strings attached.
phrases.transliteration: Xian gei shanyi, bu qiu huibao.

phrases.english: Warm words can change someone’s day.
phrases.chinese: 一句温暖的话，能改变化一天。
phrases.transliteration: Yi ju wen nuan de hua, neng gai bi hua yi tian.

phrases.english: Hold the door, please, take care.
phrases.transliteration: Bang wo fu yi xia men kou, xiexie.

phrases.english: Let them go first, you’re kind.
phrases.transliteration: Ni xian qing ba, zhen shanliang.

phrases.english: Happiness starts with one small step.
phrases.transliteration: Xìngfú cóng yí ge xiǎo bù kāishǐ.

phrases.english: I feel light, when I breathe slowly.
phrases.chinese: 我慢慢呼吸，觉得很轻松。
phrases.transliteration: Wǒ mànman hūxī, juéde hěn qīngsōng.

phrases.english: Today, my heart is full of warmth.
phrases.transliteration: Jīntiān wǒ xīnli hěn wēnnuǎn.

phrases.chinese: 好消息来了， 一切都更好。
phrases.transliteration: Hǎo xiāoxi lái le, yīqiè dōu gèng hǎo.

phrases.english: I smile, and the day feels nicer.
phrases.transliteration: Wǒ yī xiào, tiān jiù gèng hǎo.

phrases.english: Start small, then make it better.
phrases.chinese: 先从小处开始, 再把它做得更好.
phrases.transliteration: Xiān cóng xiǎo chù kāishǐ, zài bǎ tā zuò de gèng hǎo.

phrases.english: Try a twist, and see what happens.
phrases.chinese: 换个花样试试, 看看会怎样.
phrases.transliteration: Huàn gè huāyàng shì shì, kànkan huì zěnmeyàng.

phrases.english: Mix two ideas, make something fresh.
phrases.chinese: 把两个想法混在一起, 做点新东西.
phrases.transliteration: Bǎ liǎng gè xiǎngfǎ hùn zài yìqǐ, zuò diǎn xīn dōngxi.

phrases.english: Write it down, then think again.
phrases.chinese: 先写下来, 然后再想一想.
phrases.transliteration: Xiān xiě xiàlái, ránhòu zài xiǎng yí xiǎng.

phrases.english: Tell me your idea in one sentence.
phrases.chinese: 把你的想法用一句话说出来.
phrases.transliteration: Bǎ nǐ de xiǎngfǎ yòng yì jù huà shuō chūlái.

phrases.english: I breathe, and my mind softens.
phrases.chinese: 我呼吸着, 心慢慢放松。
phrases.transliteration: Wo hu xi zhe, xin man man fang song.
Ci ke, wo xuan ze ping jing.

phrases.chinese: 把肩膀放松下来, 轻轻地。
phrases.transliteration: Ba jian bang fang song xia lai, qing qing de.

phrases.chinese: 担心可以等, 我在这里。
phrases.transliteration: Dan xin ke yi deng, wo zai zhe li.

phrases.chinese: 眼神放柔, 思绪安静, 好吗？
phrases.transliteration: Yan shen fang rou, si xu an jing, hao ma?

phrases.english: Slow down, hear the endings clearly.
phrases.transliteration: man yi dian, ba wei yin ting qingchu

phrases.english: Read aloud, let your ears learn.
phrases.chinese: 大声朗读，让耳朵先学会。
phrases.transliteration: da sheng lang du, rang er duo xian xue hui

phrases.chinese: 别着急，开口前先深呼吸。
phrases.transliteration: bie zhao ji, kai kou qian xian shen hu xi

phrases.english: Repeat after me, then answer naturally.
phrases.chinese: 跟我念一遍，再自然回答。
phrases.transliteration: gen wo nian yi bian, zai zi ran hui da

phrases.english: If you forget, say it again.
phrases.transliteration: wang le ye mei shi, zai shuo yi ci

phrases.english: Thanks for correcting me so kindly.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你这么温柔地纠正我。
phrases.transliteration: xie xie ni zhe me wen rou de jiu zheng wo

phrases.english: I really appreciate your clear explanations.
phrases.chinese: 我真的很感谢你讲得这么清楚。
phrases.transliteration: wo zhen de hen gan xie ni jiang de zhe me qing chu

phrases.english: Thank you for encouraging me today.
phrases.transliteration: xie xie ni jin tian gu li wo

phrases.english: Your feedback helps me improve fast.
phrases.chinese: 你的反馈让我进步很快。
phrases.transliteration: ni de fan kui rang wo jin bu hen kuai

phrases.english: Thank you for making practice easy.
phrases.chinese: 谢谢你让练习变得很容易。
phrases.transliteration: xie xie ni rang lian xi bian de hen rong yi
